anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: And so that we may be led more to see the thing said, we shall take some example which will guide us upon the thing thought: if some house-builder never having built a house should come upon building, upon this house we shall find both the first and the beginning.
pass_b_english: And so that we may be led more fully to see what is being said, we shall take an example that will guide us to the thought. If some builder who has never built a house should come to building, we shall find in this house both the first and the beginning.
source_text: Καὶ ἵνα μᾶλλον ἐπαχθῶμεν ἰδεῖν τὸ λεγόμενον, παράδειγμα τι ληψόμεθα, ὃ ὁδηγήσει ἐπὶ τὸ νοούμενον ἡμᾶς· εἰ οἰκοδόμος τις μη||δέποτε οἰκοδομήσας οἰκίαν ἐπὶ τὸ οἰκοδομεῖν ἔλθοι, ἐπὶ ταύτης τῆς οἰκίας καὶ τὸ πρῶτον [κ]αὶ τὴν ἀρχὴν εὑρήσομ[εν].
